title: Flexbox vs. CSS Grid — Which is Better?
summary: Jen Simmons explains the difference between CSS Flexbox and CSS Grid, and when to use each. She makes the case that Grid does not replace Flexbox and most sites use both.
why: Recommended as a short, clear rundown of one-dimensional versus two-dimensional layout.

quote.text: Here's a great explanation from Jen Simmons that really helped me understand the differences
